---
title: "About"
---

I am a spatial data scientist and GIS professional working at the intersection of public health, remote sensing, and integrated pest management.

My primary focus is turning environmental and surveillance data into tools that help teams prioritize effort, understand risk, and communicate decisions early.

## Areas of interest

- Spatial data science for vector control
- Integrated pest management
- Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS)
- Mosquito surveillance dashboards
- Public-health GIS communication
- Reproducible notebooks and open-source tools
